title: New GTA6 Screenshots Compare Real-Life Cars to In-Game Vehicles
description: New Grand Theft Auto VI screenshots have been released with side-by-side comparisons of real-life vehicles and in-game models, featuring West Coast Customs recreations of iconic GTA cars and Rockstar's 'Launch Gallery' drop ahead of the November 19, 2026 launch.
youtubeTitle: GTA 6 Screenshots Compare Real Life Cars to In-Game Models
socialHook: New GTA 6 screenshots side-by-side compare real-life cars to in-game vehicles.

sections.heading: Official Screenshot Release
paragraphs: Rockstar Games and third-party creator HypeDrive have released a series of new Grand Theft Auto VI screenshots featuring side-by-side comparisons of in-game vehicles with their real-life counterparts. The comparisons highlight the fidelity of Rockstar's vehicle designs, showing real-life versions of the Grotti Cheetah Albany Manana donk Bucaneer lowrider Ivetero Coquette and Pegassi Tempesta police car all reportedly recreated with help from West Coast Customs contracted by Rockstar Games. Additionally DiscussingFilm released eight exclusive GTA 6 screenshots and Rockstar's own Launch Gallery drop includes 39 new images showcasing protagonists Lucia and Jason new interiors and heist scenarios ahead of the November 19 release.

sections.heading: Community Rumors and Player Discoveries
paragraphs: While the screenshot comparisons and real-life car recreations are attributed to Rockstar-contracted West Coast Customs and reported by gaming media independent player communities have uncovered unverified claims of hidden Easter eggs secret locations and alternate mission variants in pre-release GTA 6 build footage. These player discoveries remain unconfirmed by Rockstar Games and should be distinguished from official announcements as community rumors rather than established facts.
